adjudication.rationale: In `GoogleCalendarService.updateEvent` and `deleteEvent`, the fallback branch runs only when `externalCalendarId` is falsy, but then does `event.destinationCalendar?.find(cal => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)`, comparing against that same falsy value (null/undefined/"") and thus almost always returning `undefined`. This is newly introduced by the diff (previously it used `event.destinationCalendar?.externalId`) and can lead to `selectedCalendar`/`calendarId` being undefined when no `externalCalendarId` is provided.
